facts.text: Sam and Evan hiked trails last week, and the views were described as amazing.

evidence.quote: We all hiked the trails last week - the views were amazing!

facts.text: Sam recalls hiking with his father when he was ten years old, and describes the experience as great fun and really special for them.

evidence.quote: I did this hike with my dad way back when I was ten. Going hiking together was great fun, and really special for us.

facts.text: Sam mentions that he and his father hiked a good distance, which was quite a feat for him back then.

evidence.quote: We hiked a good distance - quite a feat for me back then.
